description.value:
Whenever you score a critical hit or drop a creature to 0 hit points, you may target a number of creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your Charisma modifier (minimum one), and apply one of the following effects, your choice, to each of them:

  • The creature gains temporary hit points equal to 1d6 plus your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).
  • The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or be frightened of you until the start of your next turn.
